# Code of conduct

Animama follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)
in its issues, discussions, pull requests and community spaces such as its
Discord.

Report unacceptable behaviour to the maintainer, Raymond Van, at
ray@animama.ai. Reports are read only by the maintainer and kept confidential.
The maintainer decides on and applies the Covenant's enforcement guidelines.
